## Choices

The labelled values of every closed or model setting above.

??? note "`threats.attackers[].id`"

 | Value | Label | Meaning |
 |---|---|---|
 | `threat/attacker/legacy/ConstPos` | Fake position: frozen | Keeps claiming the first position it sent while it drives on. |
 | `threat/attacker/legacy/ConstPosOffset` | Fake position: shifted | Claims a position a constant distance from where it is. |
 | `threat/attacker/legacy/RandomPos` | Fake position: random | Claims a random position near itself, redrawn every message. |
 | `threat/attacker/legacy/Teleport` | Fake position: teleporting | Jumps its claimed position every fourth second. |
 | `threat/attacker/legacy/SineWavePos` | Fake position: weaving | Swings its claimed position from side to side across its lane. |
 | `threat/attacker/legacy/ConstSpeedOffset` | Fake speed: shifted | Adds a constant offset to the speed it claims. |
 | `threat/attacker/legacy/RandomSpeed` | Fake speed: random | Claims a random speed. |
 | `threat/attacker/legacy/StopAndGo` | Fake speed: stop-and-go | Alternates its claimed speed between stopped and fast. |
 | `threat/attacker/legacy/ReversedHeading` | Fake heading: reversed | Claims to be driving the opposite way. |
 | `threat/attacker/legacy/HeadingOffset` | Fake heading: shifted | Adds a constant offset to the heading it claims. |
 | `threat/attacker/legacy/DataReplay` | Replay attack | Re-sends its own earlier messages with their old timestamps. |
 | `threat/attacker/legacy/SlowDrift` | Fake position: slow drift | A position error that grows slowly from nothing, hard to notice. |
 | `threat/attacker/legacy/AlongRoadOffset` | Fake position: along the road | Shifts its claimed position along the road, so it stays on the map. |
 | `threat/attacker/legacy/Sybil` | Ghost vehicles (Sybil) | Sends extra signed messages for ghost vehicles that do not exist, each under its own valid pseudonym. |
 | `threat/attacker/legacy/DelayedMessages` | Delayed messages | Stamps its messages with a stale generation time. |
 | `threat/attacker/legacy/InvalidSignature` | Invalid signature | Signs with a key that does not match its certificate. |
 | `threat/attacker/legacy/ExpiredCert` | Expired certificate | Presents a certificate past its validity. |
 | `threat/attacker/legacy/NotYetValid` | Certificate not yet valid | Presents a certificate whose validity has not begun. |
 | `threat/attacker/legacy/OutOfOrder` | Out-of-order timestamps | Stamps messages with times that go backwards. |
 | `threat/attacker/legacy/Disruptive` | Everything inconsistent | Falsifies position, speed and heading at once, inconsistently. |
 | `threat/attacker/legacy/PosSpeedInconsistent` | Moving while claiming to stop | Its position advances while it claims to be almost stopped. |
 | `threat/attacker/legacy/PosHeadingInconsistent` | Sideways while claiming straight | Its position swings sideways while it claims a straight heading. |
 | `threat/attacker/legacy/EventualStop` | Fake stop | Drives honestly, then freezes its claimed position while claiming to creep. |
 | `threat/attacker/f2md/FeignedBraking` | F2MD: feigned braking | Claims hard braking: its true acceleration negated and multiplied. |
 | `threat/attacker/f2md/AccelerationMultiplication` | F2MD: acceleration multiplied | Claims its true acceleration multiplied. |
 | `threat/attacker/f2md/PositionMirroring` | F2MD: mirrored position | Claims a position mirrored across the road edge, on the opposite side. |
 | `threat/attacker/f2md/ZeroSpeedReport` | F2MD: zero speed | Claims to be stopped while it drives on. |
 | `threat/attacker/f2md/UniformRandomPos` | F2MD: random position | Claims a position drawn uniformly over the map on every message. |
 | `threat/attacker/f2md/ConstSpeed` | F2MD: constant speed | Draws one speed once and claims it on every message. |
 | `threat/attacker/f2md/RandomSpeedOffset` | F2MD: random speed offset | Adds a fresh bounded offset to its true speed on every message. |
 | `threat/attacker/f2md/NeighbourReplay` | F2MD: neighbour replay | Restates a neighbour's latest claim under its own pseudonym. |
 | `threat/attacker/f2md/DoSDisruptive` | F2MD: disruptive flood | Beacons at a multiplied rate, each message a random neighbour's claim. |
 | `threat/attacker/f2md/DataReplaySybil` | F2MD: replay, Sybil | Restates neighbours' claims, changing pseudonym with the victim. |
 | `threat/attacker/f2md/DoSRandomSybil` | F2MD: random flood, Sybil | Beacons at a multiplied rate, random content under each next pseudonym. |
 | `threat/attacker/f2md/DoSDisruptiveSybil` | F2MD: disruptive flood, Sybil | Beacons at a multiplied rate, neighbours' claims under each next pseudonym. |
 | `threat/attacker/evasion/BenignClassMimic` | Evasion: posing as a benign device | A legacy attack worn behind a benign device class's markings. |
 | `threat/attacker/insider/ReportPoisoning` | Insider: false misbehaviour reports | Beacons honestly, but files false misbehaviour reports against honest vehicles. |
 | `threat/attacker/legacy/DoS` | Message flood (DoS) | Not runnable yet: a flood needs extra transmissions per interval. |
 | `threat/attacker/legacy/DoSRandom` | Random flood (DoS) | Not runnable yet: a flood needs extra transmissions per interval. |
 | `threat/attacker/legacy/VruImpersonation` | Posing as a pedestrian | Not runnable yet: a BSM does not carry a station type. |
 | `threat/attacker/legacy/VruPositionSpoof` | Fake pedestrian | Not runnable yet: a BSM does not carry a station type. |
 | `threat/attacker/legacy/FakeHazard` | Fake hazard warning | Not runnable yet: the host does not send an attacker's event messages. |
 | `threat/attacker/legacy/SelectiveDrop` | Drops relayed messages | Not runnable yet: vehicles here relay nothing. |

??? note "`threats.jammers[].id`"

 | Value | Label | Meaning |
 |---|---|---|
 | `attacker/jammer/constant` | Constant | A constant wideband jammer: continuous OFDM-like noise in the channel, entering every receiver's noise term for as long as it is on. |
 | `attacker/jammer/pulsed` | Pulsed | A duty-cycle jammer: wideband noise for a fraction of a fixed period, with a per-jammer phase drawn from the Attack stream. |
 | `attacker/jammer/reactive` | Reactive | A reactive jammer: wideband noise only while energy above a trigger threshold is sensed, which is the profile whose losses are uncorrelated with SINR dips. |

??? note "`threats.compromised_rsu_attack.id`"

 | Value | Label | Meaning |
 |---|---|---|
 | `threat/attacker/compromised-rsu` | Compromised roadside unit | A trusted unit under an attacker's control poisons or drops what it relays. |

??? note "`threats.eavesdropper.id`"

 | Value | Label | Meaning |
 |---|---|---|
 | `threat/observer/passive-privacy` | Roadside eavesdropper | Passive sniffers at a share of the signalised junctions try to link each car's pseudonyms. |
